title: Initial speed conversion
description: Essential: Student correctly converts 36 km/h to 10 m/s.

title: Accelerated motion speed
description: Essential: Student calculates final speed after acceleration as 15 m/s using v = v0 + a1*t1.

title: Braking time calculation
description: Important: Student determines braking time using t = v/a2, yielding 1.5 s.

title: Braking distance formula
description: Important: Student applies correct kinematics formula (e.g., x = (v/2)*t or v²/(2a)) for braking distance.

title: Final braking distance
description: Essential: Student obtains correct braking distance of 11.25 m.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Student uses wrong sign for deceleration in kinematics equations.

title: Incorrect unit conversion
description: Pitfall: Student fails to convert km/h to m/s or makes arithmetic error in conversion.
